title: Daily-life proof: eat, work, shop, sleep loop

architecture_review.rationale: Touches economy and character state ownership, but stays additive inside existing application/domain boundaries with no save-schema change.

player_outcome: The founder can complete one working day: eat a meal, work a farming shift for wages, buy food at the market stall, and sleep to restore energy, with each action advancing time and updating needs and money.
acceptance_criteria: Eat restores hunger and advances time.
Work advances a shift duration, costs energy and hunger, and pays a fixed wage.
Shop buys a food item at a fixed price, subtracting money and granting the item or immediate meal.
Sleep advances several hours, restores energy, and costs hunger.
Each action reports success or failure (for example insufficient money or energy) through a clear result.
No changes to save schema version; money and needs already serialize through the existing DTO.
EditMode tests cover each action and its failure conditions.
save_impact: none; existing schema version 1 covers money, hunger, and energy
